chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi reported to us, saying: Ali ibn Ishaq al-Makhrami narrated to me, saying: Uthman ibn Abdillah al-Shami narrated to us, saying: Ibn Luhay'ah narrated to us, from Abu Zur'ah al-Hadhrami, from Umar ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib, from his father (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: "O Ali! Indeed, through us God has sealed the religion, just as through us He initiated it, and through us God will unite your hearts after enmity and hatred."

key_terms.العداوة: Enmity — hostility and antagonism between people
key_terms.ختم: Sealed/completed — indicating finality and perfection of the religion
key_terms.فتح: Opened/initiated — referring to the beginning of the divine message
key_terms.يؤلف: Unites/reconciles — bringing hearts together in harmony

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the role of Ahlul Bayt in completing Islam?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) addressed Imam Ali (AS), declaring that God sealed and initiated the religion through the Prophet and his family (Ahlul Bayt). He further stated that God will unite the hearts of the believers through them after a period of enmity and hatred. This hadith was recorded in the context of affirming the central role of the Ahlul Bayt in the preservation and completion of Islam, echoing the Quranic theme of God uniting hearts (3:103, 8:63) and completing the religion (5:3).
